change: Add the three game IDs to the existing JAX flying-leader set. Shared terrain rules charge 2 on plain, road, forest and water while the leader is alive. Death disables flight; resurrection restores it.
scope_note: Only these three classifications changed. Other classifications, including the inherited Banshee entry, and the existing dead-leader travel rules are outside this correction.
coverage: Explicit leader cases independent of the implementation ID set, with a walking control.

Resurrection restores flight and boots; revived allowances with +20% boots are Duke 24, Counselor 42 and Dryad 30, based on Gunits MOVE 20, 35 and 25.
Terrain observation and human snapshot recognize the initial Duke as flying.
